title: Locker
description: Cloud file storage of your own: a spec-sheet file locker where every account gets a private library — folder tree, drag-and-drop uploads (whole folders walk in), inline previews for images, PDFs, text, audio, and video, starring, trash, search, and one-click public share links that revoke as easily as they mint. Ships with a seeded demo library so the first open shows a working locker, and a clear-library action that hands it back empty. Files ride the storage kernel end to end: bytes PUT straight to signed cloud-storage URLs up to 100MB, never proxied through functions.

theme.$comment: Mono-utility worn as an application, dark reading: the fund-index/dj spec-sheet register (graph paper, hairlines, Plex Mono labels) as working chrome instead of marketing, printed in reverse — light ink on a near-black ground, same darkroom family as the images pack. The register's inks ride as the project brand so kernel surfaces (login, settings) stay ink-on-ground instead of default blue. The palette carries the spec sheet's exact grounds so the AppShell chrome and the locker's panels read as one surface — its dark values are the pack's pre-AppShell art constants verbatim; the light values are the same sheet printed the right way round.
